svg.aria-label: Idea: replay the corpus into stellar-rpc, how it would fit: Corpus (635 ledger variants); Replay harness (one session per ledger); Expected answers (worked out from the ledger); stellar-rpc adapter (feeds it one ledger, then asks); Answer checks (getTransaction, getEvents…); stellar-rpc (the released binary, unchanged). Stamp: xdrproof, Idea, not in the SCF #46 proposal.
